title: Taiwan celebrates its National Day holiday against background of Chinese threats
description: China claims the self-governing island republic as its own territory.

title: Most Taiwanese willing to fight if China invades island, finds survey
description: Fears of a Chinese invasion of the self-ruled island have risen lately as China continues to stress the commitment to reunify Taiwan with the mainland

title: Most Taiwanese believe China unlikely to invade in coming five years, poll shows
description: Most Taiwanese believe China is unlikely to invade in the coming five years but do see Beijing as a serious threat to the democratic island, a poll by Taiwan’s top military think tank showed on Wednesday.

title: Poll says most Taiwanese believe China won’t invade in coming 5 years. A false sense of security?
description: The survey of around 1,200 people conducted last month by the Institute for National Defence and Security Research showed 61% of people think it was 'unlikely or very unlikely' that China would attack Taiwan in the coming five years

title: Taiwan's Resilience Amid China's Mounting Threats
description: A recent poll by Taiwan's top military think tank reveals most Taiwanese view China as a serious threat but doubt an invasion will happen in the next five years. Though there is a split on U.S. military intervention, many are ready to defend the island.

title: Taiwan Tensions: Lai Ching-te's Independence Stance Sparks Chinese Response
description: Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te's upcoming speech in Taipei has drawn criticism from China, which accuses him of promoting Taiwan independence. Beijing views Taiwan as its territory and warns of possible military drills. Lai, in contrast, asserts Taiwan's separate identity and seeks dialogue with China.

title: China accuses Taiwan President Lai of escalating tension with 'sinister intentions'
description: China accused Taiwan President Lai Ching-te of 'escalating hostility and confrontation with sinister intentions' after he recently remarked how it is 'impossible' for China to become Taiwan's motherland as Taiwan has older political roots

title: Tensions Rise: Taiwan President Lai Challenges Beijing's Policies Amid Independence Debate
description: Taiwan President Lai Ching-te's upcoming speech may provoke a military response from China, which considers Lai a 'separatist.' Despite China's claim over Taiwan, Lai's government asserts their separate identity. Tensions rise as China plans drills, while the U.S. urges peace.

title: Taiwan president is escalating tensions, China says ahead of key speech
description: Lai Ching-te will give his main national day speech on October 10, which marks the overthrow of the last Chinese dynasty in 1911 and the ushering in of the Republic of China

title: Tensions Rise as Taiwan's President Challenges China's Sovereignty Stance
description: Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te is challenging China's claims over Taiwan, with a provocative speech expected to stir a military response. Lai, labeled a separatist by China, insists Taiwan's people alone can decide their future. Tensions escalate ahead of Taiwan’s national day celebration.
